answer: Each new agent must lock a 300 POA bond for 30 epochs before it may grade or earn, whether it books ocean freight, rents island cabins or sells ember-fired pottery. A farm of 100 fakes therefore freezes 30,000 POA, and any fake that peers catch copying loses its whole stake. Splitting funds across many wallets does not help, because the bill is per identity, not per sender, and a rented key still needs its own bond and its own wait. A real agent pays this once, keeps working normally, and gets the full bond back when its scores stay clean.
